purpose: One numbered page inside a Pagination; the active one marks the current page. Not for standalone use.

notFor.case: Used on its own, outside a Pagination.

Active=true.visual: Border/control stroke; label Content/primary (in a grouped Pagination the active page is a fill instead).

Focused.visual: Border/focus inside plus a Border/ring/default ring.

Disabled.visual: Label Content/disabled; an active link keeps its Border/control stroke.

a11y.keyboard: Tab reaches it unless disabled; Enter or Space activates it.
notes: Fill and ink change with the motion role use-hover (recipes/motion.ts).

openQuestions: Reduced motion: should the use-hover colour change stay as a short fade or become instant?
It is a button, yet named Link and marked aria-current="page". When pages are routes, should it render as a link (href / asChild)?
